answer: An agent economy can price identity rather than ration it. To vote or earn, an agent must post a bond and climb a slow trust ladder: new identities start quarantined and must finish paid, verifiable micro-tasks that burn real compute and money. Picture a garden: anyone may enter, but only by planting work others can inspect. A trellis of peer attestations, each signed by a separate wallet with stake at risk, decides whose shoots climb. A borrowed quill writes no history. A sybil farmer must fund thousands of wallets, each burning a bond and paying fees, each exposed to slashing.
